acceptance.assertion: On a fresh user profile with the scheduler state directories absent, each canonical cycle or closure service can enter its Python entrypoint because the exact writable state path is created declaratively or by the bound installer before systemd applies ReadWritePaths.

ProtectHome, NoNewPrivileges, private temporary storage, address-family restrictions and the read-only drift contract remain at least as strict as the T017 baseline; no broad home-directory write access or self-healing is introduced.
Existing installations with private 0600 user units and current state data remain valid; the implementation does not require world-readable unit files or rewrite historical state.
Focused fresh-profile tests, exact diff-bound self-review and the full relevant Bureau validation pass on one exact revision.

approval.note: Implement only declarative or installer-bound creation of the exact scheduler state directories plus focused tests and documentation. Runtime deployment, unit restart and foreign-work override remain excluded.

goal: Make the canonical Bureau cycle and closure units start correctly when their user-state directories do not yet exist, without weakening service hardening, changing current deployment truth or introducing self-healing.

metadata.finding: The T017 installer and activation guide do not establish the state directories named by ReadWritePaths. The current Heim-PC already has them, so current-host validation does not establish fresh-profile startup.
metadata.outcome: Bureau PR #1507 adds exact private systemd StateDirectory declarations for all five scheduler stages, validates the paths and modes fail-closed, and proves fresh-profile entrypoint reachability without deploying or restarting the live runtime.

validated_acceptance.fresh-state-start: PASS — all five services declare exact StateDirectory paths at mode 0700; the parametrized fresh-profile test begins without those directories and reaches every Python entrypoint after declarative setup.
validated_acceptance.hardening-preserved: PASS — exact ReadWritePaths, ProtectHome=read-only, NoNewPrivileges, private temporary storage and address-family restrictions remain; broad state writes fail closed.
validated_acceptance.existing-host-compatibility: PASS — changes are additive unit declarations only; no live deployment, unit-mode requirement, historical-state rewrite or service restart occurred.
validated_acceptance.tests-review-ci: PASS — 52 focused tests, systemd verification, 1111 full tests plus 18 subtests, exact diff self-review and exact-head GitHub CI passed.

validation: PR #1507 exact-head validate (3.10), validate (3.12), CodeQL, analyses and Registry freshness passed.
Focused fresh-profile validation passed 52 tests and systemd-analyze --user verify for all ten service/timer files.
Local full validation on the byte-identical scheduler tree passed 1111 tests and 18 subtests; Registry, Systemkatalog and SQLite integrity passed.
The implementation was merged through GitHub merge queue as ce341e1724cbd50b50c0eda879268b83860dbcde.
does_not_establish: a real fresh-host boot outside the isolated tests

title: Make Bureau scheduler state directories fresh-host safe
